note: Suggestions review section. Nothing here is implemented until it is reviewed and chosen on /suggestions/ — the chooser records a choice locally and applies nothing. IDs SG-21..SG-26 are reserved for parallel sessions and are intentionally absent.

paths.name: Path A — Single-category air fryer shop
paths.summary: Publish as a focused air-fryer buyers' shop; park the two thermometer links until a later decision.
paths.consequences: Fastest route to topical depth and clean internal linking; two verified products (P-04, P-05) stay out of the shop; if the owner intended both categories, this loses the thermometer cluster.

paths.name: Path B — Two-room kitchen publication (current build)
paths.summary: Two category rooms under one publication: Air Fryers and Meat Thermometers, each with its own guide cluster and product shelf.
paths.consequences: Covers all five verified links; more editorial work per week; category pages and sitemap stay honest about scope; fully reversible to Path A by removing one section.

paths.name: Path C — Hold publication, dashboard only
paths.summary: Ship no buyer-facing guides until the compliance gate (Special Link test, tracking ID confirmation, intended ASINs) is closed; keep only the register and flagged pages public.
paths.consequences: Zero compliance exposure while the gate is open; no organic traffic and no click data; misses the publishing window.

suggestions.title: Lead with products, not with the verification process
suggestions.body: Rebuild the landing page as a publication front page: product shelf and guides first; every dashboard surface reachable from the footer and one dashboard nav group.

suggestions.title: Publish question-shaped guides on a set cadence
suggestions.body: Working titles (editorial hypotheses, not popularity claims): Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare? · A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity · How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs · Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance · plus one thermometer guide to cover the second category.
suggestions.status: implemented in this build (5 guides shipped)

suggestions.title: Turn on click and conversion measurement before writing anything else
suggestions.body: Ship the privacy-preserving outbound-click counter, the five documented events, and the self-hosted endpoint code first, so every later article is chosen from measured queries instead of instinct.
suggestions.status: implemented in this build (endpoint code shipped; deployment pending)

suggestions.title: Disclosure above the fold on every page, repeated in the footer
suggestions.body: A disclosure strip sits under the masthead on every page and is repeated in the footer, using the exact Associates §5 sentence, checked by the build gate.

suggestions.title: Mark every outbound product link as sponsored
suggestions.body: All product links carry rel="sponsored nofollow" (Google's paid-link qualification) and the owner-supplied tracking tag; the gate fails the build if either is missing.

suggestions.title: Build a product-intent confirmation record with never-merged fields
suggestions.body: intended_asin / intended_listing_url / confirmation_date / intent_source stay blank until confirmed; observed redirect target / date / source are stored separately.
suggestions.status: implemented in this build (intended fields blank on all five)

suggestions.title: Replace ambiguous outbound links with validated Special Links — one link per product first
suggestions.body: Test one link per product in the enrolled Associates workflow; confirm destination and tracking report before scaling. Do not claim the supplied short links are invalid; their status is unresolved (FLG-003).
suggestions.impact: commission is only paid on properly formatted links

suggestions.title: Keep an empty but well-defined campaign ledger
suggestions.body: Columns: timestamp, source, channel, eligible sessions, clicks, reported orders, provenance. Rows are added only when obtained from authorized first-party reports. No conversion score or revenue forecast is presented anywhere.
suggestions.status: implemented in this build (ledger empty by design)

suggestions.title: Put disclosures and API policy checks into the publishing workflow
suggestions.body: scripts/check_site.py is the gate: disclosure strip present above <main> on every page, footer disclosure present, every product link sponsored + tagged, every data-table row carries a source link, internal links resolve, sitemap covers every page. It must pass before any push.

suggestions.title: Offer three complete paths and record the choice without applying it
suggestions.body: The chooser on /suggestions/ compares Path A / B / C on consequences and gates; the control records the chosen path in this browser only and applies no change to the site.

suggestions.title: Keep editorial hypotheses labelled as hypotheses
suggestions.body: Every working title carries the caveat that it is not a claim about popularity, search volume, or product superiority. Titles get replaced by measured queries once Search Console data exists.

suggestions.title: Source product imagery only from official Program Content
suggestions.body: No hotlinked or scraped images. The build ships a text-forward design; real product imagery is added only through Associates link-builder / PA API output after account approval.

suggestions.title: Add the site to Search Console and submit the sitemap
suggestions.body: After the site is live: add the property, verify ownership, submit sitemap.xml, then choose the next topic from measured queries.
suggestions.prerequisite: Q-07 canonical domain, Q-09 owner action

suggestions.title: Ship the RSS feed and internal link clusters on day one
suggestions.body: feed.xml lists every guide; each guide links to its category shelf and sibling guides (air-fryer cluster, thermometer cluster) so crawlers and readers can move in both directions.

suggestions.title: Plan seasonal hooks without inventing demand data
suggestions.body: Editorial calendar placeholders: holiday gifting (thermometers), game-day cooking (air fryers), summer grilling. Dates are planning slots only — no volume claims.

suggestions.title: Human editorial pass rule: every claim carries a source or comes out
suggestions.body: Standing rule for all future content: a sentence that cannot point to an official source (or to first-party measurement once available) is deleted, not softened. Product specs come from the listing; comparisons stay structural (capacity, form factor, cleanup), never superiority scores.

suggestions.title: Compare with 'who it's for' framing, not numeric scores
suggestions.body: Guides compare form factors and trade-offs in plain language. No star ratings, no scores, no 'best' superlatives — product ratings were not captured from the listings' own rating blocks and stay blank (FLG-007 discipline).

suggestions.title: A/B test guide titles from measured queries
suggestions.body: Once Search Console reports queries, re-title underperforming guides from real query wording and measure. Until then, titles stay editorial hypotheses.

suggestions.title: Reader capture with a privacy-first provider
suggestions.body: Optional email capture for the guide series; requires a provider decision, a privacy policy line, and an unsubscribe path before any form ships. No form ships in this build.

suggestions.title: Publication-style nav labels (parallel-pass row)
suggestions.body: Nav labels read like a magazine, not an admin panel: 'Shelf' for products, 'Guides' for articles, 'Field Notes' for analysis; dashboards live in one footer group.

suggestions.title: Shipped RSS feed (parallel-pass row)
suggestions.body: feed.xml (RSS 2.0) is generated from the guide registry and listed in the footer; every new guide is added to the feed and sitemap by the build.

suggestions.title: Search Console (parallel-pass row)
suggestions.body: Checklist ships on the platform page; the actual property add/verify/submit is an owner action (FLG-008, Q-09).

suggestions.title: Reader capture (parallel-pass row)
suggestions.body: Same gate as SG-19 — provider and privacy review before a single input field appears.
